data.name: Coaster of Carnage VR
data.detailed_description:
Take a true thrill ride on a deserted roller coaster through a spooky, gore filled carnival! Coaster of Carnage is a short virtual reality roller coaster ride with a Halloween horror theme. Guts and gore, clowns and cadavers, blood and bones, spiders and a cohort of Satans rejects! What could be more fun? Great for scaring friends and family! Not intended for the faint of heart.


Leap Motion Controller Support

Coaster of Carnage VR is a short (about 8 minutes) horror genre rollercoaster experience. Perfect for scaring the daylights out of your friends!

Full version scheduled for release Halloween 2018!

reviews.review:
[h1]Played On: [b]HTC Vive[/b][/h1]

[b]Revised: 12/20/17[/b]

Coaster of Carnage is the first horror-themed rollercoaster VR title so far. I don't want to elaborate on the experience too much, since doing so will give away all of the reasons to experience the game, but I will say that the pricetag is fair for the content; moreso if you grab it on sale. At this point in time, it does need a lot of work, but it's not necessarily a bad title. Hopefully the developer will listen to feedback, especially since the game is still in Early Access and is scheduled for release around Halloween of 2018. Continue reading only if you're the developer, or if you don't mind some of the gameplay being spoiled.

As of the latest update, the rollercoaster doesn't seem to be as slow as it were originally, which was one of the painpoints of the game. There are a few more scares added, and those that have arachnophobia (like me) may find themselves actually sweating a little bit for a couple of minutes. Something that still needs to be fixed is the actual coaster seat. I was unable to sit down while playing this, since the seat was far too high above me and blocked my view; I actually felt like just a torso on a coaster seat. This is something that needs to be dealt with soon, as a lot of people require seated positions for rollercoaster VR titles.

With the latest update comes some additional scares, and fixes to ones that previously existed but were bugged. The snow on the ground for December is also a nice touch. That being said,[spoiler]the falling body, chainsaw guy, cultists, and creepy girl with her whispering[/spoiler] are simply not enough. The developer has actually added me on Steam at this time, and we're in talk about what can be added to make this horror coaster more spooktacular. It would also be a good idea to add more intense ambiance to set the mood via music.

For now, I'm going to give Coaster of Carnage a recommendation, it takes on a unique concept in the world of VR and deserves some support, especially since the price is so low. I will definitely be keeping my eye on this title, and update the review accordingly. The developer is really involved in his project, so make sure to give some feedback on what you'd like to see in future updates in the forums. Keep up the good work, dev, I'm eager to see what new horrors await.

[h1]Rating: [b]3.0/5.0[/b] - Average, can take it or leave it.[/h1]
